dedupe_keys.name: local radio station model disaster recovery plan and incident response manual media security and reliability council 2005

description: This is a generic template for a local radio station's disaster recovery plan and incident response manual, developed by the Toolkit Working Group for the Media Security and Reliability Council and dated 30 November 2005. It gives guidelines for a short-term plan to resume essential services after an extended disruption from natural or man-made disaster, following the steps prepare, assess, respond, recover and evaluate. The manual covers objectives, definition of terms, distribution and maintenance of the plan, testing scenarios and their scope, vulnerability assessment and prevention, staff roles, essential equipment and services, and internal and external communication, with the incident response manual as an appendix. Document status tables and contact lists are left blank for each station to complete. Producer: MSRC Toolkit Working Group, hosted by the FCC clearinghouse. Coverage: United States radio stations, generic. Access: free PDF of 62 pages; the front matter and introduction were read. Licence and cost: free; no licence statement read. Caveats: it is a template written in 2005 with no facility data, and later FCC backup power rules are not reflected. Simulation uses: the recovery steps, essential services and roles can structure emergency-response and continuity scenarios for broadcast facilities. Related record: the FCC disaster NPRM on backup power for broadcasters (case_study-fcc-disaster-nprm-backup-power-broadcasters-dirs-2021).
